Design reference

Every component in every state. This page is rendered only by a test; it has no route. web/DESIGN.md says what each token and component means.

Pill

Type, protocol, lifecycle state, severity. Every pill carries text, so state is never shown by colour alone.

Filter form

A plain GET form: it works without a script, and htmx only swaps the results beneath it. States: empty, with text, with a select chosen.

Group

A collapsible namespace of a list: a native details element, open by default, with the count in a pill. States: open, closed.

Package rows

A tag or version row. The stage pill (stage-pill) and the severity pills (severity-pills) are shared partials, so every row, header, and table shows a verdict the same way. Below 900px the size column (.col-size) goes, below 720px the owners (.col-owners); the pills never do. The last row of a paged table is td.more-row.

Artifact header

The title leads with the name and puts the short digest second (.sub). The verdict strip (.pills.verdict) is at most four pills: stage or "revoked from", worst severity, scan age, and "new findings since approval" (.pill.new). Upstream content has no strip. The section navigation (.section-nav) sticks below the strip; under 720px the links give way to a native <details class="sections-menu">. Both are always in the markup.

Layers and size bar

A layer row carries the share of the whole as .bar inside .bar-track, widened by a data-w attribute from 1 to 10 in tenths, because a page may carry no inline style. The build step (.build-step) is shown where the image config is present.

Command block

Mono, wraps long lines and keeps newlines; the copy button stays top right. The copy button is hidden until a script sets html.js-enhanced on the page.

docker pull registry.example.com/team/app@sha256:4b825dc642cb6eb9a060e54bf8d69288fbee4904cafebabedeadbeefcafebabe

Use this panel

Client tabs are links that set ?client=, so the choice lives in the URL. A step may carry a caption; notes and the publicUrl hint follow the commands.

Install

pipuvpoetry

Once per project

poetry source add --priority=primary sindri "http://sindri.test:8080/pypi/internal/simple/"
poetry config http-basic.sindri token "$SINDRI_TOKEN"
poetry add demo==1.0

The token travels as the password of the index URL, so $SINDRI_TOKEN must be set in your shell.

publicUrl is not set; commands use the address this page was loaded from.
